**Overview:**  
Pacific Seri Freight Sdn. Bhd. is a private limited logistics company that provides cold‑chain transport and storage of frozen goods. It was incorporated on 8 June 2007 and operates out of Selangor, Malaysia. The firm has a share capital of RM 5,000,000, two directors, and a single corporate shareholder, with Gemilang Holdings Sdn. Bhd. owning 70.0% of the equity. The company has been involved in one legal case, listed as a plaintiff, with no claims against it.
